description: DT14_UC3_Riga's Public Transport Network Real-time data_GTFS_EMERALDS_20251120_v01 is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Grupa93 Ltd., ULB CoDE. This dataset was utilized in WP5: Use Cases Experimentation and Assessment Cycle within UC3: Traffic Data Analytics for the Public Transportation System, as part of the EMERALDS project. It comprises both historical and real-time GTFS Realtime data, including vehicle positions (latitude and longitude), speeds, delays, and trip adjustments. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The repository holds 2 deposits of this kind (versions, parts or per-site or per-year releases); this record describes the series through its most recent member and lists the others in the notes. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
